BiblicalUsage: Machazeh is a vision, a seeing, and it belongs to the prophets and to Abram. Genesis 15:1 says the word of the LORD came to Abram in a vision, and Numbers 24:4 and Numbers 24:16 both say Balaam saw the vision of the Almighty with his eyes open. Ezekiel 13:7 turns the word against the false prophets who claim a vain vision the LORD never gave.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a true vision is never a man's own idea dressed up in God's name: it comes from the LORD, and it is tested by whether He actually spoke. My position is that Ezekiel 13:7 is the warning label on every claim to have seen something from God.
